wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: There is confusion over Endymion's identity, as some sources suppose that he was, or was related to, the prince of Elis, and others suggest he was a shepherd from Caria.
Consequently, Endymion's tomb has been attributed to two different sites. The people of Heracleia claimed that he was laid to rest on Mount Latmus, while the Eleans declared that it was at Olympia.
she asked her cousin, Zeus, to grant him eternal youth so that he would never leave her.

wiki_only_topics.topic: Fifty daughters of Endymion and Selene
wiki_only_topics.quote_wikipedia: by him had fifty daughters who are equated by some scholars (such as James George Frazer or H. J. Rose) with the fifty months of the Olympiad.
The myth surrounding Endymion has been expanded and reworked during the modern period by figures like Henry Wadsworth Longfellow and John Keats (in his 1818 narrative poem Endymion).
